dict.string: 01 uses Calendar access when you choose to add, update or remove a workout appointment. It retrieves only the event identifiers saved for its own copies.
01 reads the movement, workout, sleep, height, and body-weight samples you choose to share to fill your profile and show useful activity context. The data 01 imports stays on this iPhone.
01 uses HealthKit access to manage your health connection. 01 does not write Health data in this beta.
01 uses the microphone only while you hold push-to-talk so you can review a local action before confirming it.
01 uses the camera only when you choose to take a progress, food or sharing photo. You review the picture before saving or sharing it.
01 saves the sharing image you reviewed to Photos only when you choose Save to Photos.
01 converts your deliberate push-to-talk audio into text on this iPhone so you can confirm a local action.
01 uses your location after you start an outdoor walk or run, including while recording in the background, to draw your route and measure distance. 01 stores the route locally.
01 counts steps during an outdoor walk or run you start. Step tracking is optional, and your activity remains on this iPhone.
01 lets you choose music from your library or Apple Music for workouts. Music is optional and starts only when you choose it.
